newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Teco GDR issue raises $110 mln.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Teco GDR issue raises $110 mln.

text.p: Taiwan's Teco Electric and Machinery Co said on Friday it had completed a global depositary receipt (GDR) issue to raise US$110 million for its operational needs.
The GDR issue, which will be listed in London, comprises 5.54 million units, with each unit representing 10 common shares, Teco said in a statement.

Each GDR unit is priced at US$20.08, with each Teco common share equal to T$55.26, a discount of seven percent compared with its average closing price for the past 30 days before setting the underwriting price, Teco said.
SBC Warburg is the issue's lead underwriter, Teco said.
Teco shares closed at T$60 on Friday, down T$3.
